review_title: Steroid‐eluting sinus stents for improving symptoms in chronic rhinosinusitis patients undergoing functional endoscopic sinus surgery
screening_criteria: We included all randomised controlled trials (RCTs) comparing steroid‐eluting sinus stents with non‐steroid‐eluting sinus stents, nasal packing or no treatment in adult CRS patients undergoing FESS.
gold_label_policy_description: dataset label 1.0 counts as INCLUDE; 0.5 and 0.0 count as EXCLUDE
